reviewContext.issueReference: tacogips/riela#163, #135, #104, #176 (riela-side remainder), #175 (verify 64a4927f, b2543045); plan review comm-000014 (step5-impl-plan-review, accepted)
reviewContext.userProblem: Four runtime issues remain open. (1) #163: a command node that exits nonzero drops its stdout, so no bounded diagnostics survive. (2) #135: --retry-failed-step rejects nodeTimeout failures, and a plain step rerun starts with an empty inbox, so downstream command nodes such as dispatch-plans fail. (3) #104: a step rerun of a protected git-finalization workflow fails late with 'authoritative workflow mode evidence is missing' when a failed attempt was followed by a successful retry. (4) #176: riela workflow validate never runs the gateway JSON request rules because no production caller passes a WorkflowValidationContext. The cherry-picked #175 fix (64a4927f, b2543045) also still needs verification.
requiredOutcomes: #175: AdapterUtilitiesTests and WorkflowStepFailurePolicyTests pass, and both commits are ancestors of HEAD.

#163: an opt-in command.failureDiagnostics policy records one non-authoritative command_failure_diagnostics backend event (captureStatus validated or rejected) on a nonzero exit. Nothing is captured by default. A nonzero exit still fails. Oversize, invalid or unexpected fields are rejected.
#135 D1: --retry-failed-step accepts a nodeTimeout current step.

#135 D2: a plain rerun carries the target's recorded accepted inbox through importAcceptedHistory. Missing or unaccepted recorded communications, and created or running sources, are rejected in preflight.
#104 D3: a protected rerun binds the latest accepted git and mode evidence, or rejects in preflight with the pinned recovery message before any session is created.

#176 V0-V5: riela workflow validate (production context only) rejects operation requests mixed with legacy keys, non-literal operations or selections, invalid config.postprocess programs (same JSONDataTransform compiler as the runtime) and unknown operations where a catalog exists. Aliases and legacy modes stay valid, and the docs matrix is updated.
swift build succeeds and swiftlint reports no new warnings in changed files.
nonGoals: Any ART migration, release or deployment work for #176.
Gateway validation in workflow inspect, run preflight, the registry or the server.
New CLI flags, request fields, GraphQL fields or store tables.
Side-effect deduplication for retried timed-out steps.
Changes to the semantics of validateGitFinalizationEvidence or to unprotected workflows.
Running the full swift test suite as a gate.
constraints: Run swift build/test and swiftlint through arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc from the repository root.
Every verification record includes integer exitStatus, testsRun and failureCount and the complete log path under tmp/issue-sweep-20261024/<plan>/.
A failed command node still fails; failure metadata never becomes acceptedOutput or rootOutput.
The runtime store owns identities. Imported executions and messages get new ids and importedFrom, and are never copied through appendWorkflowMessage.
155f1145 (fix/command-failure-metadata) is read-only reference material. Port it by hand, keeping inheritEnvironment: false.
RielaCore must not import gateway SDKs, GatewaySDKKit or JSONDataTransform.
Workers run no index- or worktree-changing git commands and record pre/post sha256 for every edit.
Blockers are dependency objects naming the out-of-scope path.
designDecisionsAndRationale: #163 stores diagnostics only as metadata on the command_failure_diagnostics backend event, so the failure stays authoritative and no store schema changes.
#135 D2 reuses the runtime-owned importAcceptedHistory path, which already enforces identity remapping, instead of appending messages.

#104 D3 binds git-evidence steps whenever their latest attempt is accepted. It binds mode steps only when they are unreachable from the target, so a full restart never inherits a stale mode. The Guaranteed check uses node-removal dominance, with planning_only routes filtered only for plan commit/push.
#176 injects the production context only in WorkflowValidateCommand.run, through a RielaCLI extension, so RielaCore stays SDK-free and the default validator behaves as before.
ISW-104 runs after ISW-135 (wave 2) because both edit Recovery.swift, RerunCarryover.swift and docs/preserved-history-recovery.md. ISW-135 pins the rerunCarriedInbox contract.
intentionalTradeoffs: A plain rerun from a created or running source, including a stale-running session left by a killed process, is now rejected (user-QA item 2).
D2 reads only inputSnapshot.mergedVariables._rielaInput, so a rerun of an add-on or output-projection target (plan-git-commit, plan-git-push) carries no inbox.
No opt-out flag restores fresh-input reruns (user-QA item 1).
Templated postprocess programs and providers without a public operation-name listing are deferred to runtime. V5 is skipped for a provider whose catalog projection returns nil.
An invalid failureDiagnostics policy is reported at runtime as a rejected receipt, not at workflow validate time.
supportedEdgeCases: Command stdout of exactly 65,536 bytes is allowed; 65,537 is rejected, or throws on exit zero with a policy.
A sibling key outside the diagnostics path is never retained.
A rerun of a target that never executed, or whose inbox holds only non-execution messages, starts fresh as before.
Completed sources can be carried over and imported.
step10 history [failed, completed] binds the completed retry.
A plan-git-commit that is Guaranteed after the target is not bound.
Gmail passthrough variablesTemplate is rejected only for Gmail tiers; Wrike, Analytics and Notion passthrough stay valid.
Selection aliases inside literal brace strings stay valid.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: X readers, legacy container readers, Google Service and Kaiba nested-argument validation (still runtime-only).
Container nodes, mock-scenario stdio executors and distributed workers for failure diagnostics.
Gated rerun suites not owned by any plan (for example SessionCommandJSONLStreamingTests) that fail because of the new behavior. These are reported as dependency objects.

acceptanceCriteria: command.failureDiagnostics is opt-in. Without it, the process configuration and behavior are unchanged: no capture limit and no event.

acceptanceCriteria: static rerunFinalizationEvidenceExecutions(workflow:source:targetStepId:available:) exists with the pinned signature. It is pure, returns [] for unprotected workflows, and is wired into both the plain and preserve-history rerun paths.
Latest accepted git evidence (commit, push, integration, plan commit/push) is bound. Mode steps are bound only when unreachable from the target. A failed-then-retried step binds the completed retry.
Incomplete evidence is rejected in preflight with the exact pinned recovery message; no session is created and no adapter is invoked.
